High-dimensional baskets, rough volatility without a controlled lift, and severe discontinuities remain better served by Monte Carlo, finite differences, or adapted bases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"投影生成元定价"的确定性算子方法，用于定价路径依赖型衍生品（如美式、百慕大式、障碍、结构化产品等）。该方法将风险中性过程的无穷小生成元投影到有限基上，利用矩阵半群传播续值，避免了蒙特卡洛模拟和回归，实现了美式/百慕大期权的无回归定价、确定性 Greeks 计算，以及对有限活动跳扩散模型的支持。在谱基下对解析型收益函数的定价误差呈指数衰减。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种不依赖蒙特卡洛模拟和路径回归的确定性方法，用于高效定价路径依赖型衍生品（包括美式/百慕大期权、障碍期权、自动赎回、结构化产品等）？
AI.motivation: 传统方法对路径依赖型衍生品定价面临困难：蒙特卡洛模拟收敛慢，回归续值估计（如 Longstaff-Schwartz）存在近似误差，高维 PDE 网格计算量巨大。需要一种替代性的确定性定价框架，兼具精度和效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无穷小生成元、Galerkin 投影、矩阵指数半群、谱方法、Bellman 递归。
AI.method: 将风险中性过程的无穷小生成元投影到有限维基函数空间上，通过矩阵指数（半群）传播续值。路径依赖通过有限事件-状态转移表示。美式/百慕大期权通过投影半群传播 + 逐点执行比较 + 重新投影实现，无需路径回归。
AI.findings: 在 Black-Scholes、COS、Longstaff-Schwartz、有限差分、蒙特卡洛、Merton 跳扩散等基准测试中，该方法实现了：机器精度的欧式定价、无回归的美式定价（误差在1%以内）、确定性 Greeks、有限活动 Poisson 跳支持，以及无需路径模拟的结构化产品定价。当有限空间对生成元不变时定价精确，谱基下误差指数衰减。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种融合生成元微积分、Galerkin 投影、矩阵指数、谱基和 Bellman 递归的统一定价架构；定义了"投影残差"衡量逼近债务；证明了谱基下解析型收益函数的指数误差衰减。
AI.practical_contributions: 为路径依赖型衍生品提供了一种无需蒙特卡洛模拟和路径回归的确定性定价引擎；能够以更少的计算量获得可比或更高的精度；直接获得确定性 Greeks 而非通过重新定价差分；支持跳扩散模型和结构化产品，具有实际应用价值。

title: 'The Critical (Legal) Praxis of Costas Douzinas'

detail.title: 'The Critical (Legal) Praxis of Costas Douzinas'
detail.abstract: Douzinas’ work is made up of shards of critique that lacerate structures of power, legal orders, political regimes and economic apparatuses. Piecing these shards together does not give us a complete theory, but this chapter argues that it does contain a singular critical praxis. The chapter takes the ‘Oubliez Critique’ essay of 2005 as the centrepoint around which a praxis of critique emerges. There is no simple negation of the texts or themes under consideration, instead Douzinas begins by traversing the subject under consideration from within. The purpose of this traversal is not (or not simply) to disprove the argument, so much as exhausting the imminent possibilities of the text. In this exhaustion, new possibilities of emerge and these are understood by bringing existing critical theories to bear. From this exhaustion, the final move emerges, often in a nascent or gestural form, that is Douzinas’s critical praxis seeks to overcome and move beyond the structure or subject under consideration. The essay traces this critical praxis across Douzinas’ writings on human rights, legal theory and social movements.

AI.tldr: 本文以杜兹纳斯2005年的《Oubliez Critique》一文为中心，论证其批判作品虽然零散不成体系，但构成了一种独特的批判实践：从内部遍历研究对象、耗尽文本内在可能性、借助现有批判理论催生新可能，最终超越既定结构。
AI.research_question: 杜兹纳斯零散的批判作品是否构成一种统一的批判实践？如果是，这种批判实践的方法论特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 杜兹纳斯的批判作品以碎片化形式呈现，看似缺乏完整的理论体系，但本文认为其中蕴含着一种独特的批判实践，值得被系统阐明。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判理论；杜兹纳斯的批判实践（批评的批评、内在遍历、可能性耗尽、超越性否定）。
AI.method: 文本分析：以杜兹纳斯2005年《Oubliez Critique》为轴心，追溯其批判实践在其人权、法律理论和社会运动著作中的运用。
AI.findings: 杜兹纳斯的批判实践包含三个步骤：①从内部遍历研究对象；②耗尽文本的内在可能性（而非简单否定）；③借助现有批判理论催生新可能，最终以萌芽或姿态形式超越既有结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统化阐明了杜兹纳斯碎片化作品中隐含的批判实践方法论，揭示了其"从内部耗尽再超越"的独特批判路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为批判理论研究者提供了一种可借鉴的批判实践操作范式，展示了如何在人权、法律理论和社会运动等具体领域中运用这种批判方法。

title: Terminal Portfolio Value Distribution to Machine Precision

detail.title: Terminal Portfolio Value Distribution to Machine Precision
detail.abstract: We present a deterministic, semi-analytical framework for computing the complete distribution of a portfolio’s terminal value at horizon 𝑇 for correlated lognormal assets. Unlike traditional approaches, this method requires no Monte Carlo simulation. It directly yields the full probability density, the cumulative distribution, all moments, and exact quantile metrics such as loss Valueat-Risk (VaR) and loss Expected Shortfall (ES). The method is not closed-form in the classical sense (no finite elementary formula exists for the sum-of-lognormals distribution), but it achieves machine precision through a rapidly converging spectral scheme with controllable error. The method builds on the Hermite-COS representation (Nagy, 2026): the terminal portfolio value distribution is expressed as a finite trigonometric polynomial whose coefficients are computed from Gauss-Hermite quadrature over the correlation eigenstructure. The CDF is then a deterministic sine series, the PDF is a cosine series, the lower-tail terminal-value quantile is obtained by root-finding on the CDF, and the corresponding loss VaR and loss ES follow immediately from 𝐿𝑇 = 𝑆0−𝑆𝑇 . Both the quadrature and the spectral expansion converge exponentially, so with standard parameters (𝑄 = 40, 𝑁 = 128) the results match Monte Carlo to 4–5 significant figures — deterministically, in under one second. We demonstrate and validate the framework on three $100,000 portfolios spanning the practitioner landscape: 1. Bitcoin-heavy crypto portfolio (𝜎max = 90%, skewness = 3.6): extreme volatility where delta-normal underestimates the 1% loss by $128,000 — more than the portfolio itself. The Hermite-COS method matches Monte Carlo (5M paths) to within $53 on VaR. 2. Long-short equity hedge portfolio (net +40%, gross 200%): positions that can go negative. The method matches MC VaR 1% to within $10, natively handling short positions. 3. Diversified 60/40 multi-asset portfolio: the standard institutional setup. Matches MC VaR 1% to within $27, revealing $4,687 of hidden tail risk that the Gaussian assumption misses. All results are validated against Monte Carlo with 5 × 106 paths. Every risk measure agrees to 4–5 significant figures. The Hermite-COS computation completes in 0.4–0.8 seconds per portfolio and is perfectly deterministic: running the same portfolio twice always gives the same answer, unlike Monte Carlo where the VaR 1% fluctuates by $19–$21 between seeds.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于Hermite-COS谱方法的半解析框架，能够在无需蒙特卡洛模拟的情况下，快速、确定性地计算相关对数正态资产组合的终端价值完整分布，包括VaR和ES等风险指标，精度达到4-5位有效数字。
AI.research_question: 如何在无需蒙特卡洛模拟的情况下，高效且精确地计算相关对数正态资产组合的终端价值完整分布及其风险度量？
AI.motivation: 传统蒙特卡洛方法计算组合风险时结果具有随机性、耗时较长，且delta-normal等近似方法在高波动率或结构复杂组合中严重低估尾部风险。需要一种确定性、快速且高精度的替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Hermite-COS表示（Nagy, 2026）：将终端组合价值分布表示为有限三角多项式，系数通过相关特征结构上的Gauss-Hermite求积计算。CDF为正弦级数，PDF为余弦级数，尾部分位数通过CDF求根获得。
AI.method: Hermite-COS谱方法：结合Hermite多项式展开与COS（余弦级数）方法，利用Gauss-Hermite求积计算谱系数，通过可控误差的快速收敛谱方案达到机器精度。求积和谱展开均指数收敛。
AI.findings: 在三个组合（比特币重仓加密组合、多空股票对冲组合、60/40多资产组合）中，Hermite-COS方法在0.4-0.8秒内得到结果，与500万路径蒙特卡洛相比，VaR 1%误差分别仅$53、$10、$27，达到4-5位有效数字。delta-normal法在高波动率组合中低估尾部风险达$128,000。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Hermite-COS表示从数学构造拓展为可实际应用于金融组合风险管理的完整计算框架，证明了谱方法在非封闭形式（对数正态和）分布计算中的理论可行性与指数收敛性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了无需模拟、完全确定性、亚秒级精度的组合风险计算工具，能处理极端波动率、空头头寸等复杂情况，揭示了高斯假设下的隐藏尾部风险，适用于高频风控和监管合规场景。

title: Spectral Importance Sampling: Optimal Rare-Event Simulation via Eigenvalue-Conditioned Measure Change

detail.title: Spectral Importance Sampling: Optimal Rare-Event Simulation via Eigenvalue-Conditioned Measure Change
detail.abstract: Rare financial catastrophes are the events that matter most for risk management and the ones standard Monte Carlo handles worst: a one-in-a-million loss needs about a million samples to appear even once. Importance sampling addresses this by simulating under a tilted measure that makes rare events common and then correcting each sample by a likelihood ratio, but the central difficulty is choosing the tilt — in a portfolio of hundreds of correlated assets the space of tilts is vast and a poor choice increases variance rather than reducing it. This paper shows that the eigenvalue decomposition of the correlation matrix supplies a provably optimal tilting direction. The key structural fact is mode independence: the eigenvalue-weighted modes are mutually independent, so the measure change factorizes into independent per-mode exponential tilts, each with a closed-form saddle-point solution. The optimal tilt is computable in O(K) operations, independent of portfolio dimension. I establish three results. First, the factored estimator is unbiased and logarithmically efficient, with second moment bounded by C(l) times rho^(-2l), where rho > 1 is the analyticity radius of the portfolio characteristic function and l is the loss threshold. Second, the optimal per-mode tilt is the saddle point of the per-mode cumulant generating function, and the collection solves a separable convex program in the large-threshold regime. Third, there is a duality between the Bernstein ellipse radius governing spectral coefficient decay and the Cramer rate function governing tail probabilities, so the optimal importance-sampling domain coincides with the analyticity domain of the spectral representation. The variance reduction is exponential in the loss threshold for marginals with analytic characteristic functions and polynomial for heavy-tailed marginals (Student-t, Pareto, stable). I demonstrate the method on deep-tail VaR/ES estimation at the 10^-8 level, multi-asset barrier option pricing with correlated knock-out, and CDO tranche loss estimation under correlated defaults.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于特征值分解的最优重要性抽样方法，通过将相关性矩阵分解为独立模态，在O(K)复杂度内实现稀有金融灾难事件（如10^-8分位数的VaR/ES）的高效模拟，方差随损失阈值呈指数级衰减。
AI.research_question: 如何在高维相关资产组合中有效选择重要性抽样的倾斜方向，从而高效估计极端稀有金融事件的尾部风险？
AI.motivation: 标准蒙特卡洛模拟在处理稀有金融灾难（如百万分之一损失）时效率极低，需要大量样本才能观察到一次事件。重要性抽样虽能解决这一问题，但在数百种相关资产的组合中，倾斜空间巨大且选择不当会增大方差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 特征值分解（Eigenvalue Decomposition）、模式独立性（Mode Independence）、鞍点近似（Saddle-Point Approximation）、累积量生成函数（Cumulant Generating Function）、对数效率（Logarithmic Efficiency）、Cramér速率函数、Bernstein椭圆。
AI.method: 提出基于相关性矩阵特征值分解的最优重要性抽样方法：利用特征值加权的模态之间相互独立，将测度变换分解为每个模态独立的指数倾斜，每个倾斜都有闭式鞍点解。算法复杂度O(K)，与组合维度无关。
AI.findings: 1) 因子化估计量无偏且对数效率，二阶矩边界为C(l)·ρ^(-2l)；2) 最优模态倾斜是模态累积量生成函数的鞍点，在大阈值下求解可分离凸规划；3) Bernstein椭圆半径与Cramér速率函数存在对偶关系，最优重要性抽样域等于谱表示的分析域；4) 对具有解析特征函数的边际分布，方差随损失阈值指数衰减；对重尾分布（Student-t, Pareto, 稳定分布）为多项式衰减。
AI.theory_contributions: 发现了特征值分解中的模式独立性这一关键结构事实，建立了重要性抽样最优倾斜方向与谱表示分析域之间的对偶关系，将高维相关资产组合的稀有事件模拟问题简化为可分解的凸优化问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 在10^-8级别的深度尾部VaR/ES估计、多资产障碍期权定价、CDO分档损失估计等实际金融风险管理场景中实现高效且方差显著降低的模拟，算法复杂度与资产数量无关，适用于大规模投资组合。

title: Reclaiming the Soul of Education: The Swiss Patriciates as a Model for Sustainable Learning and Societal Development
affiliations: The Swiss Institute for Alternative Thinking and The Swiss Institute for Alternative Thinking

detail.title: Reclaiming the Soul of Education: The Swiss Patriciates as a Model for Sustainable Learning and Societal Development
detail.abstract: In a world increasingly marked by disconnection—between individuals, between societies, and between humanity and nature—the necessity of reintegrating education with life itself becomes ever more pressing. The modern educational paradigm, often mechanised and detached from its environmental and communal roots, stands in stark contrast to models that have survived the test of time by embracing a holistic, nature-based, and community-driven approach to knowledge transmission. The Swiss Patriciates offer a striking case study of such a system. As an exemplary case integrating a variety of “devices suited for tackling international policy priorities in modern times, with a particular focus on the field of sustainability", they embody an educational ethos that seamlessly intertwines childhood development, communal stability, and environmental stewardship leading to befitting notions of responsibility and evolution on both the individual as well as collective level. Being a mode of organization that has community integration at its roots, it promotes individuals assuming responsibility themselves rather than being directed towards doing so, embodying a real hope- one that acts organically.  The bottom-up approach employed showcases the requirements for a foundation rooted in heritage that can drive healthy innovation that is in congruence with both inner and outer nature, and not just in accordance to a mental motto such as “progress”. This paper explores the relevance of this model to contemporary educational challenges and the ways in which it provides a pathway toward a more integrated, sustainable, and meaningful existence.

AI.tldr: 本文以瑞士Patriciates阶层为案例，探讨了一种 holistic、基于自然和社区驱动的教育模式，认为这种将教育与生活本身重新整合的模式，为应对现代教育因机械化、脱离环境与社区根基而导致的个体与社会层面的疏离问题提供了启示，并倡导一种自下而上、植根于传统、与内外自然和谐共生的可持续发展路径。
AI.research_question: 瑞士Patriciates阶层所代表的整体性、基于自然和社区的教育模式，如何为当代教育面临的脱节与疏离挑战提供可行的替代路径？
AI.motivation: 现代教育范式日益机械化、脱离环境与社区根基，导致个体间、社会间以及人与自然的疏离；有必要重新审视那些历经考验、采用整体性教育模式的历史案例，以寻求更整合、可持续的教育理念。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整体性教育（holistic education）；基于自然的教育（nature-based education）；社区驱动教育（community-driven education）；自下而上的组织模式（bottom-up approach）；传统与创新的辩证关系（heritage-driven innovation）。
AI.method: 以瑞士Patriciates阶层作为典型案例进行历史与模式分析。
AI.findings: 瑞士Patriciates的教育模式将儿童发展、社区稳定和环境管理融为一体，促进个体主动承担责任，而非被动接受指令；这种自下而上、植根于传统的方式能够驱动与内外自然和谐一致的健康发展，超越单纯追求“进步”的现代性口号。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新唤起了整体性教育模式在当代的理论价值；将传统（heritage）作为创新（innovation）的基础而非对立面，丰富了教育变革理论；提出了一种“有机希望”（organic hope）的概念，区别于自上而下的、指令式的希望。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当代教育政策制定者和实践者提供了一种可供借鉴的历史范式；提示教育应重新嵌入社区生活与自然环境，以应对可持续发展等国际政策优先事项。

title: When Text Helps: AI Text Signals for Calibration-Sensitive Tail-Risk Decisions in Prediction Markets
affiliations: University of Waterloo - Department of Management Sciences and University of Waterloo - Department of Management Sciences

detail.title: When Text Helps: AI Text Signals for Calibration-Sensitive Tail-Risk Decisions in Prediction Markets
detail.abstract: Prediction markets provide a demanding benchmark for event-driven risk assessment because prices aggregate dispersed beliefs in real time. Public text streams create a second information layer that price histories do not always summarize immediately. This paper examines whether AI-extracted public text improves calibrationsensitive downside-risk assessment beyond price-based benchmarks, and whether that value varies with the top-two price gap. The analysis uses Polymarket data covering 186 events and 22,071 event-day observations. It links an auditable daily text-measurement pipeline to rolling out-of-sample evaluation of next-day downside-tail risk. Nonlinear price-state modeling explains much of the improvement over a linear price-history baseline. AI-HGB adds a smaller text-layer increment beyond Price-HGB, with the clearest gains in calibration and selected threshold-based decision outcomes. State-contingency evidence shows that directional text becomes less diagnostic as the top-two price gap widens. The findings position AI-extracted text as an auditable measurement layer for risk-sensitive decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文利用 Polymarket 186个事件的22071条日度数据，研究了AI从公开文本中提取的信息能否在价格基准之上改善事件驱动的下行风险评估，发现非线性价格状态建模解释了大部分改进，而AI文本层的增量贡献较小，且在价差扩大时文本的诊断价值下降。
AI.research_question: AI提取的公开文本信息能否在基于价格的基准模型之上，改善对预测市场事件驱动的下行尾部风险的评估？这种改善是否随前两名价格差距的变化而变化？
AI.motivation: 预测市场的价格虽能实时聚合分散信念，但公开文本流构成了价格历史无法即时概括的第二信息层。探索AI文本能否提升风险敏感的下行风险评估，对风险决策支持具有重要的实践和理论意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非线性价格状态建模、价格基准模型（Price-HGB）、AI文本增强模型（AI-HGB）、校准敏感的下行风险评估框架。
AI.method: 使用Polymarket的186个事件、22071条事件-日观测数据；构建可审计的每日文本测量管道；进行滚动样本外评估，预测次日下行尾部风险；比较线性价格历史基线、非线性价格状态模型（Price-HGB）和AI文本增强模型（AI-HGB）的表现。
AI.findings: 非线性价格状态建模（Price-HGB）相比线性价格历史基线有显著改进；AI-HGB在Price-HGB基础上增加了较小的文本层增量，最明显的提升体现在校准度和特定阈值决策结果上；状态依赖性证据表明，随着前两名价格差距扩大，方向性文本的诊断价值下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了非线性价格状态建模在事件驱动风险评估中的关键作用；证明了AI文本层在校准敏感的风险评估中的增量价值及其条件性；识别了价格差距对文本信息诊断价值的调节效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为风险敏感决策支持提供了可审计的AI文本测量层；为预测市场参与者提供了结合价格与文本信息进行下行风险评估的实操框架；为监管者和风险管理者利用公开文本信息改善风险评估提供了方法论基础。

title: When the Magazine Doesn't Empty: Cargill's Textualist Definition of Automatic Operation and the Federal-law Capture of Agentic Artificial Intelligence

detail.title: When the Magazine Doesn't Empty: Cargill's Textualist Definition of Automatic Operation and the Federal-law Capture of Agentic Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract: In Garland v. Cargill, 602 U.S. 406 (2024), the Supreme Court resolved a long-running debate over the statutory definition of "machinegun" under the National Firearms Act of 1934 by holding that bump stocks do not satisfy the definition because each shot still requires a separate mechanical function of the trigger. The en banc Fifth Circuit in Cargill v. Garland, 57 F.4th 447 (5th Cir. 2023), reached the same conclusion through textualist statutory construction, and the Northern District of Texas extended the reasoning to forced reset triggers in National Association for Gun Rights v. Garland, 741 F. Supp. 3d 568 (N.D. Tex. 2024), with the Department of Justice subsequently dismissing the government's appeal and adopting the district court's position by settlement. Through this sequence the firearms-rights litigation movement secured a narrow, mechanical, textualist construction of "automatic" operation under 26 U.S.C. § 5845(b): one input event producing continuous output, with no further input required between rounds. This Article argues that the textualist construction the firearms-rights movement won definitionally captures agentic artificial intelligence as it is now deployed. A single human deployment instruction directing an AI agent to execute multi-step tasks, manage resources, contract with third parties, and persist across time satisfies the literal textualist test that Cargill and NAGR established: a single function of the trigger producing continuous output without further input. The result is a cross-aisle doctrinal convergence that neither political coalition can easily resist. The textualist methodology that produced the firearms-rights victory binds the courts that apply it to other federal definitional questions. The functional-equivalence methodology that the gun-control movement urged in Cargill applies with greater force to agentic systems whose practical continuity exceeds anything contemplated in 1934. The 1934 statutory ceiling on autonomous operation, which caps at continuous fire until manual reload, leaves no doctrinal vocabulary for systems that source their own continuation through external compute markets, cryptocurrency wallets, and contracted services. This Article develops the statutory architecture, the post-Cargill application landscape, the application of the test to AI deployment, the doctrinal vacuum beyond the 1934 ceiling, the cross-aisle convergence, the standing implications, and the regulatory architecture that the federal regulatory state has used to address autonomous operation in adjacent contexts and that supplies a structural model for addressing it here. The honest political history of conditional anti-regulation, beginning with the Mulford Act of 1967 and the National Rifle Association's support for prohibiting open carry in response to the Black Panther Party, is addressed because it establishes the conditions under which contemporary anti-regulation coalitions support regulation in practice. Those conditions are present for agentic AI. The doctrinal road is built; both coalitions paved it; what remains is application.

title: Exchange Rate Channel of the Monetary Policy Transmission Mechanism: Evidence from West African Monetary Zone (WAMZ)
affiliations: Central Bank of Nigeria

detail.title: Exchange Rate Channel of the Monetary Policy Transmission Mechanism: Evidence from West African Monetary Zone (WAMZ)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Personal

detail.abstract: This study examines the exchange rate channel of the monetary policy transmission mechanism in the West African Monetary Zone (WAMZ). The study is motivated by the persistent exchange-rate pressures, import dependence, inflation volatility and weak monetary policy transmission that continue to challenge macroeconomic stability and monetary integration in the zone. Using annual panel data for The Gambia, Ghana, Guinea, Liberia, Nigeria and Sierra Leone from 1990 to 2025, the study employs a Panel Vector Error Correction Model following evidence of unit roots and cointegration among consumer price index, gross domestic product, exchange rate, monetary policy rate and money supply. Impulse response functions and forecast error variance decomposition are used to trace the dynamic effects of exchange-rate shocks on inflation and output. The findings show that the exchange rate channel is active in WAMZ, but its effect is stronger on inflation than on economic growth. Inflation responds positively and persistently to exchange-rate shocks, while output response is weaker and less stable. Variance decomposition further shows that exchange-rate shocks account for a rising share of inflation variation but explain only a modest share of output fluctuations. The study concludes that exchange-rate stability is central to inflation control and monetary policy credibility in WAMZ. It recommends stronger foreign exchange management, improved reserve buffers, better monetary-fiscal coordination and structural policies to reduce import dependence and strengthen domestic productive capacity.

AI.tldr: 本研究运用面板向量误差修正模型（PVECM）分析了1990-2025年西非货币区（WAMZ）六国的数据，发现汇率渠道在货币政策传导机制中是活跃的，但对通胀的影响强于对经济增长的影响，汇率稳定对于通胀控制和货币政策可信度至关重要。
AI.research_question: 西非货币区（WAMZ）货币政策传导机制中的汇率渠道如何运作？汇率冲击对通胀和产出的动态影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 西非货币区持续面临汇率压力、进口依赖、通胀波动和货币政策传导不畅等问题，这些挑战阻碍了该区域的宏观经济稳定和货币一体化进程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策传导机制的汇率渠道理论；购买力平价与利率平价理论；货币一体化理论。
AI.method: 使用1990-2025年冈比亚、加纳、几内亚、利比里亚、尼日利亚和塞拉利昂的年度面板数据，采用面板向量误差修正模型（PVECM），并运用脉冲响应函数和预测误差方差分解分析汇率冲击的动态效应。
AI.findings: （1）汇率渠道在WAMZ是活跃的，但对通胀的影响强于对经济增长的影响；（2）通胀对汇率冲击呈正向且持久的响应，而产出的响应较弱且不稳定；（3）方差分解显示汇率冲击解释了通胀变动的上升份额，但对产出波动的解释力有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 为西非货币区这一特定区域提供了汇率渠道传导机制的实证证据，验证了汇率渠道在发展中经济体货币联盟中的非对称效应（对通胀影响大于产出）。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议加强外汇管理、提高储备缓冲、改善货币财政协调以及实施结构性政策以减少进口依赖和增强国内生产能力，为WAMZ货币政策制定和汇率稳定管理提供了政策依据。

title: A Review of Contest Theory: Equilibrium Strategies and Incentive Design
affiliations: Department of Economics, Nanjing University, Lingnan College, Sun Yat-sen University and National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Economics

detail.title: A Review of Contest Theory: Equilibrium Strategies and Incentive Design
detail.abstract: Contest theory studies strategic competition among individuals or groups for rewards such as positions, market share, or rents. Owing to its wide applicability in settings such as rentseeking, promotion, litigation, political competition, and research and development (R&D), the theory has become a core field of microeconomics. Taking the classical models as our point of departure, this paper reviews the literature on equilibrium analysis and contest design. Within this scope, it examines several central issues, including prize allocation, contestant heterogeneity, budget constraints, contest technologies, and information disclosure. Finally, it summarizes promising directions for future theoretical research and potential extensions.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了竞赛理论（Contest Theory）的经典模型与前沿发展，围绕均衡分析和竞赛设计两大主线，探讨了奖金分配、参赛者异质性、预算约束、竞赛技术及信息披露等核心议题，并指出了未来理论研究的方向。
AI.research_question: 竞赛理论在均衡分析和竞赛设计方面的核心议题有哪些？未来理论研究的潜在方向是什么？
AI.motivation: 竞赛理论广泛应用于寻租、晋升、诉讼、政治竞争和研发等领域，已成为微观经济学的核心领域。为系统梳理已有成果并指导未来研究，有必要对经典模型及后续发展进行全面综述。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞赛理论（Contest Theory），涉及均衡分析、竞赛设计、奖金分配、参赛者异质性、预算约束、竞赛技术、信息披露等。
AI.method: 文献综述法，通过对经典模型及后续研究的系统梳理和归纳。
AI.findings: 竞赛理论在奖金分配方式（如奖金结构、渐进式奖励）、参赛者不对称性、预算约束下的策略行为、不同竞赛技术（如Tullock形式、全支付拍卖）以及信息披露策略等方面取得了丰富的理论成果。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了竞赛理论在均衡分析与竞赛设计两大方向上的文献，厘清了多个核心议题的研究脉络与内在联系，为后续理论拓展提供了清晰的参照框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织竞赛设计（如企业晋升制度、R&D竞赛、政治竞选规则等）提供了理论指导，有助于优化资源配置、提升激励效率和控制竞赛成本。

title: When Walls Become Targets: Strategic Speculation and Price Dynamics under Price Limit
affiliations: Peking University School of Economics and Peking University - School of Economics

detail.title: When Walls Become Targets: Strategic Speculation and Price Dynamics under Price Limit
detail.abstract: This study shows that price limit rules, though intended to stabilize markets, distort price dynamics by enabling strategic speculation. Through a rational expectations model, we demonstrate that price limits induce inherent post limit-up price-jumps by impeding full information incorporation. This motivates speculators to artificially push prices to the upper bound and profit at the expense of uninformed traders. The model predicts two distinct patterns: (1) stocks closing at upper price limits earn positive overnight returns followed by long-term reversals, and (2) stocks retreating from upper bound before market close incur significant loss for speculators and demonstrate a "collapse-underperformance" pattern. Empirical evidence confirms both predictions. China's 2020 GEM reform, which widened the price limit from 10% to 20%, provides further causal evidence that relaxed limits mitigate speculative distortions. Our model also captures several well-documented empirical patterns associated with price limits, including the magnet effect, volatility spillover, and delayed price discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文研究涨跌停制度如何通过阻碍信息充分融入市场，引发策略性投机，导致价格扭曲。通过理性预期模型，预测并验证了两种价格模式，并利用中国创业板改革作为自然实验提供因果证据。
AI.research_question: 涨跌停制度如何通过影响信息融入过程，诱发策略性投机行为并扭曲价格动态？
AI.motivation: 涨跌停制度旨在稳定市场，但现实中观察到诸多异常价格模式（如磁吸效应、隔夜跳涨、长期反转等），缺乏统一理论解释其投机扭曲机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理性预期模型，信息摩擦理论，策略性投机理论
AI.method: 理性预期理论建模 + 实证检验（双重差分等）+ 中国创业板2020年改革（涨跌幅从10%放宽至20%）作为准自然实验进行因果识别
AI.findings: (1) 涨停收盘股出现正的隔夜收益但长期反转；(2) 触及涨停但回落股呈现"崩溃-跑输"模式，投机者遭受显著损失；(3) 放宽涨跌幅限制显著缓解了投机扭曲。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为涨跌停制度下的磁吸效应、波动溢出和价格发现延迟等多种现象提供了统一的理论解释框架，揭示了涨跌停作为信息摩擦源的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管层评估与改革涨跌停制度提供了理论依据和因果证据，支持放宽涨跌幅限制可减少市场投机扭曲的政策方向。

title: Exchange Rate Passthrough to Inflation: Evidence from Selected Sub-Saharan African Countries
affiliations: Central Bank of Nigeria

detail.title: Exchange Rate Passthrough to Inflation: Evidence from Selected Sub-Saharan African Countries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Personal

detail.abstract: This study investigates the extent and dynamics of exchange rate pass-through (ERPT) to inflation in Nigeria, Kenya, and Ghana over the period 2010Q1-2025Q3 using a dynamic panel framework. Motivated by the open-economy New Keynesian Phillips Curve, inflation is modeled as a function of monetary policy stance, market interest rates, exchange rate movements, external trade performance, and aggregate output. The empirical analysis applies the Pooled Mean Group (PMG) estimator within a panel ARDL framework, which allows for country-specific short-run heterogeneity while imposing long-run equilibrium convergence. Panel unit root tests confirm a mixture of I(0) and I(1) processes, validating the ARDL-PMG approach. The results provide strong evidence of a stable long-run relationship between inflation and key macroeconomic fundamentals across the three economies. Short-run dynamics, however, are highly heterogeneous. In Nigeria, exchange rate depreciation exerts large and immediate inflationary effects, indicating rapid and substantial pass-through driven by high import dependence. In Kenya, inflation responds more strongly to monetary policy adjustments and output fluctuations, with muted short-run exchange rate effects. Ghana exhibits delayed but broader ERPT, with lagged exchange rate movements, monetary indicators, and real-sector conditions jointly shaping inflation dynamics. The error-correction terms are negative and significant across countries, indicating gradual adjustment toward long-run equilibrium, though at differing speeds. Overall, the findings demonstrate that ERPT in Sub-Saharan Africa is incomplete, asymmetric, and strongly country-specific in the short run, despite a shared long-run structure. The study underscores the need for coordinated inflation-management strategies that combine credible monetary policy, exchange rate stabilization, and structural reforms aimed at reducing import dependence and strengthening productive capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2010Q1-2025Q3的面板数据，采用PMG估计器研究尼日利亚、肯尼亚和加纳三国汇率传递对通胀的影响，发现长期存在稳定关系但短期异质性显著，汇率传递不完全、非对称且具有国家特异性。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚、肯尼亚和加纳这三个撒哈拉以南非洲国家的汇率传递（ERPT）对通货膨胀的影响程度和动态特征如何？
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲国家普遍面临汇率波动和高通胀挑战，但现有研究对汇率传递在该地区的异质性和动态特征关注不足，缺乏多国比较的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放经济新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线（Open-Economy New Keynesian Phillips Curve），将通胀建模为货币政策立场、市场利率、汇率变动、外部贸易表现和总产出的函数。
AI.method: 面板ARDL框架下的Pooled Mean Group（PMG）估计器，允许短期异质性但强制长期均衡收敛；面板单位根检验验证了I(0)和I(1)混合序列，支持ARDL-PMG方法的适用性。
AI.findings: ①三个经济体存在稳定的长期通胀关系；②短期动态高度异质：尼日利亚汇率贬值有快速且显著的通胀效应，肯尼亚通胀对货币政策调整和产出波动更敏感，加纳呈现延迟但更广泛的汇率传递；③误差修正项显著为负，调整速度因国而异；④汇率传递不完全、非对称且具有国家特异性。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了开放经济新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线在撒哈拉以南非洲的适用性，揭示了长期结构趋同与短期异质性并存的汇率传递特征，丰富了发展中经济体汇率传递的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国央行制定通胀管理策略提供实证依据，强调需要结合可信的货币政策、汇率稳定措施和降低进口依赖的结构性改革，采取协调但因地制宜的政策组合。

title: Catalan Separatism: A Municipal Level Spatial Analysis of Population Density, Income, and Pro-Independence Sentiment

detail.title: Catalan Separatism: A Municipal Level Spatial Analysis of Population Density, Income, and Pro-Independence Sentiment
detail.abstract: This study tests the notion that Catalan separatism is driven by economic discontent and an urban–rural divide, examining whether pro‑independence sentiment is higher in rural areas facing greater economic challenges. Using municipal‑level data for 947 municipalities, it compares support for ERC and CDC in the 2016 parliamentary elections to population density and average household income, based on official Spanish administrative and survey data. Spatial statistics and regression techniques are applied to identify clustering and estimate the association between these factors and pro‑independence sentiment. The analysis reveals a clear urban–rural divide, with separatist support varying systematically across space, and shows that both population density and income are significantly related to independence preferences once spatial dependence is accounted for. Together, these patterns suggest that Catalan separatism cannot be reduced to simple economic grievance; the political leanings of neighboring municipalities exert a stronger influence on separatist support than average household income alone. More broadly, spatially embedded socioeconomic conditions play a central role in shaping political support for independence.

AI.tldr: 本研究检验了加泰罗尼亚分离主义是否由经济不满和城乡差异驱动，发现分离主义支持存在明显的城乡差异，且邻近城市的政治倾向比平均家庭收入对分离主义支持的影响更大。
AI.research_question: 加泰罗尼亚分离主义是否由经济不满和城乡差异驱动？农村地区的经济困境是否与更高的独立倾向相关？
AI.motivation: 理解加泰罗尼亚分离主义的深层驱动力，检验“经济不满”和“城乡对立”这两种常见解释是否成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间依赖理论、经济不满理论、城乡分化理论
AI.method: 使用加泰罗尼亚947个市镇的市级数据，运用空间统计和回归技术，分析2016年议会选举中对ERC和CDC两个分离主义政党的支持率与人口密度、平均家庭收入之间的关系。
AI.findings: 分离主义支持存在明显的城乡差异；在控制空间依赖后，人口密度和收入均与独立倾向显著相关；邻近市镇的政治倾向对分离主义支持的影响大于平均家庭收入的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了将加泰罗尼亚分离主义简单归因于经济不满的简化观点，强调了空间嵌入的社会经济条件在塑造政治独立支持中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解加泰罗尼亚独立运动的复杂性提供实证依据，提示政策干预需要考虑空间邻近效应和地理背景。

title: Active Mutual Fund Co-holdings and the Buy-side Peer Network
affiliations: City University of Hong Kong (CityU), City University of Hong Kong (CityU),  and City University of Hong Kong (CityU)

detail.title: Active Mutual Fund Co-holdings and the Buy-side Peer Network
detail.abstract: Peer groups in cross-stock return tests are usually specified by the researcher rather than observed from investor behavior. We use active mutual fund holdings to define peer groups from buy-side portfolio choices. In U.S. equities from 1990 to 2024, holdings-based peer returns predict next-month focal-stock returns. Predictability is concentrated among nearest holdings-space peers, absent for the least similar stocks, and robust to industry, shared-analyst, common-ownership, and characteristics-based controls. Peer fundamentals and earnings news also forecast focal-firm fundamentals. A value-weighted long-short portfolio earns 0.67% per month with significant alphas. Post-formation returns continue rather than reverse, and the signal is not subsumed by common ownership. The predictive slope is larger among high-friction focal stocks. A simple model links these patterns to limited investor coverage and gradual price adjustment.

AI.tldr: 本文利用主动管理型共同基金的持仓数据来定义股票的同群组，发现基于持仓的同群组收益能显著预测焦点股票的下月收益，且该效应不能被行业、共同分析师、共同所有权等传统因素所解释。
AI.research_question: 基于投资者行为观察到的同群组（而非研究者预先定义的）是否能预测股票收益？
AI.motivation: 传统研究中同群组由研究者主观定义，而本文希望从买方投资组合选择中观察真实的同群关系，检验其对股票收益的预测能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限投资者覆盖与渐进价格调整模型：同群组收益信息通过有限关注的投资者逐步传递，导致价格渐进调整。
AI.method: 利用1990-2024年美国主动管理型共同基金持仓数据，基于持仓相似度定义同群组，构建持仓空间最近邻的同群收益指标，进行收益预测回归分析，并构建多空组合检验经济意义。
AI.findings: (1) 持仓空间最近邻同群收益显著预测焦点股票下月收益；(2) 最不相似股票的预测效应消失；(3) 效应在控制行业、共同分析师、共同所有权和特征后依然稳健；(4) 同群基本面与盈利新闻也能预测焦点公司基本面；(5) 多空组合月收益0.67%，存在显著alpha；(6) 收益持续而非反转，不被共同所有权所吸收；(7) 高摩擦股票中预测效应更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从实际投资者行为（而非研究者设定）定义同群组，揭示了基于持仓同群组的信息传导机制，丰富了有限关注与价格渐进调整的理论文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了基于共同基金持仓同群组的可交易信号（多空组合月收益0.67%），并提示高摩擦股票中存在更强的预测效应，有助于投资策略优化。

reference: The Foundation for Law & International Affairs Review, Volume 6, Issue 1, Pp. 149-174
title: Organised Interests and the Neoliberal Turn: Assessing the Role of Organizations and Political Interests in Moving Mainstream Left Parties Toward Free Market Policies

detail.title: Organised Interests and the Neoliberal Turn: Assessing the Role of Organizations and Political Interests in Moving Mainstream Left Parties Toward Free Market Policies

publicationDetails.detailsText: The Foundation for Law & International Affairs Review, Volume 6, Issue 1, Pp. 149-174

detail.abstract: This paper examines why Western mainstream left parties embraced neoliberalism and free-market economic policies in the late 20th century. Existing literature often attributes this shift to the rising affluence of the median voter and the need for parties to adapt to changing economic conditions. While influential, this explanation is incomplete. Drawing on Hacker and Pierson's concept of "politics by organised interests", this paper argues that the neoliberal turn was primarily driven by changing relationships between mainstream left parties and their affiliated organizations and political constituencies. A historical single-case analysis of the American Democratic Party illustrates this dynamic. In the mid-20th century, the party relied heavily on labor unions and social justice groups, which wielded significant influence over its policy agenda, pushing it toward social democratic policies. From the 1970s onward, the declining electoral leverage of these groups reduced their influence, while the Democrats increasingly sought support from wealthy investors and business interests. This realignment pushed the party toward free-market economic policies that reflected the priorities of its new allies. These findings illuminate similar processes in other Western mainstream left parties and provide insight into their responses to the Great Recession and their electoral challenges in the 2010s. By foregrounding the role of organized interests, this paper offers a more robust explanation for the neoliberal drift of mainstream left parties than median-voter theories alone.

AI.tldr: 本文认为，20世纪末西方主流左翼政党转向新自由主义，并非主要源于中间选民日益富裕等经济因素，而是由于政党与有组织利益集团之间关系的变化——当劳工组织和社会正义团体的影响力下降，而富有的投资者和商业利益集团的影响力上升时，左翼政党转向了亲市场政策。
AI.research_question: 为什么20世纪末西方主流左翼政党会接受新自由主义（自由市场）经济政策？
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常将左翼政党的新自由主义转向归因于中间选民日益富裕和政党适应经济变化的必要性，但这种解释并不完整。本文试图提供一个更充分、更有力的解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: Hacker和Pierson提出的"有组织利益集团驱动的政治"（politics by organised interests）概念。
AI.method: 历史单案例研究分析（historical single-case analysis），以美国民主党为分析对象。
AI.findings: 20世纪中期，美国民主党严重依赖劳工工会和社会正义团体，这些团体对其政策议程具有重大影响力，推动其走向社会民主政策。1970年代起，这些团体的选举影响力下降，而民主党日益寻求富裕投资者和商业利益集团的支持。这种重组（realignment）使民主党转向反映新盟友优先事项的自由市场经济政策。
AI.theory_contributions: 超越了中间选民理论的解释框架，将有组织利益集团的作用置于分析中心，为理解主流左翼政党的新自由主义漂移提供了更稳健的解释。研究结论也有助于理解这些政党在大衰退和2010年代选举挑战中的应对方式。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了左翼政党政策转向的内在政治机制，有助于理解当代西方左翼政党的选民基础变化、选举困境及其政策回应逻辑。

title: Causal Effects of Social Media Sentiment on Cryptocurrency Market Returns and Volatility
affiliations: , Westcliff University, Westcliff University and University of the Cumberlands

detail.title: Causal Effects of Social Media Sentiment on Cryptocurrency Market Returns and Volatility
detail.abstract: Cryptocurrency markets are highly sensitive to social media sentiment. Yet, the causal direction of these effects remains elusive owing to the predominance of correlational approaches that fail to address confounding and reverse causality. Against this backdrop, this study provides causally identified evidence on the impact of social media sentiment on cryptocurrency returns and volatility by applying a three-stage causal machine learning framework to a daily panel of Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH) over 159 trading days (January 2-June 12, 2023). The study utilized publicly available datasets of price data from CoinMarketCap and sentiment from the Crypto Twitter Influencer Sentiment Dataset. First, the Double Machine Learning Partially Linear Regression (DML-PLR) model removed high-dimensional observable confounding using crossfitted Random Forest nuisance estimators. Second, Partially Linear Instrumental Variables (PLIV) were used to correct for treatment endogeneity, confirmed in ETH importance-weighted sentiment via Hausman pre-testing. Third, Causal Forest was employed to estimate Conditional Average Treatment Effects (CATEs) and assess heterogeneity across market regimes and influencer importance. Thereafter, a series of robustness checks (such as alternative nuisance learners, rolling-window stability analysis, leave-one-out tests, placebo and permutation diagnostics, lagged-treatment sensitivity, bootstrap and hyperparameter stability for Causal Forest, and macro-event confounder controls) were conducted to ascertain the reliability of the study findings. The results revealed a robust and consistently contrarian causal effect of sentiment on returns across all model specifications. The periods of elevated positive sentiment systematically precede price declines in tandem with a peak-optimism reversal mechanism. The strongest effect was observed for ETH, with a Causal Forest average treatment effect of-0.294 (p-value < 0.001). Significant heterogeneity was also identified. For BTC, the effect reversed sign across regimes, positive in bear markets (+0.161) and negative in bull markets (-0.133), while for ETH, the magnitude of the negative effect was amplified on high-influence days (p-value = 0.063). In contrast, no statistically significant causal effect of sentiment on realized volatility was detected, rejecting the uncertainty-amplification channel. The BTC contrarian effect remained stable across all diagnostics, whereas the ETH effect, though economically large, showed moderate sensitivity to temporal windows and heterogeneity specifications. Placebo and permutation tests rejected spurious correlation, and lagged-treatment results indicated that sentiment effects are primarily contemporaneous rather than persistent. Thus, the study advances the literature by providing rigorously causal evidence on the crypto-sentiment nexus, moving beyond the limitations of prior correlational analyses.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用因果机器学习框架（DML-PLR、PLIV、Causal Forest），基于2023年1月至6月比特币和以太坊的每日面板数据，发现社交媒体情绪对加密货币收益存在稳健的逆势因果效应（积极情绪 precede 价格下跌），但对波动率无显著因果影响。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体情绪对加密货币收益和波动性是否存在因果影响？这种影响在不同市场状态和条件下是否存在异质性？
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多采用相关性方法，无法解决混杂因素和反向因果问题，因此社交媒体情绪与加密货币市场之间的因果关系仍不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 峰值乐观反转机制（peak-optimism reversal mechanism）；不确定性放大渠道（uncertainty-amplification channel）
AI.method: 三阶段因果机器学习框架：1) DML-PLR模型（交叉拟合随机森林）去除高维可观测混杂；2) PLIV纠正处理内生性（Hausman检验确认）；3) Causal Forest估计条件平均处理效应（CATE）并检验异质性。辅以多种稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1) 情绪对收益存在稳健的逆势因果效应：积极情绪系统性 precede 价格下跌；2) ETH效应最强（ATE=-0.294, p<0.001）；3) BTC效应在熊市为正（+0.161）、牛市为负（-0.133）；4) ETH在高影响力日负效应放大；5) 情绪对已实现波动率无显著因果效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供加密货币-情绪关系的严格因果证据，超越此前相关性分析的局限；验证了峰值乐观反转机制；拒绝了不确定性放大渠道。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供反向交易策略的因果依据；提示监管者和市场参与者关注社交媒体过度乐观信号；展示因果机器学习在金融领域的应用价值。

title: Buy It Now Or Later? An Experimental Study of Second-price Auction with Buy Price
affiliations: Daito Bunka University - Department of Economics, Future University Hakodate and Daito Bunka University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Buy It Now Or Later? An Experimental Study of Second-price Auction with Buy Price
detail.abstract: This paper experimentally investigates bidder behavior in second-price auctions with a buyout option. We focus on how competition among bidders, time preference, and ambiguity about both factors affect the decision to exercise the buyout option. Using a laboratory experiment, we vary the number of bidders and introduce a rate of decay in bidder's valuation that captures the speed of loss of their interest to the object for sale. We also incorporate Knightian uncertainty regarding these factors to examine how ambiguity influences behavior. In addition, we compare the explanatory power of the standard rational model and the Level-k model. The results show that both competition and time preference significantly affect buyout decisions, consistent with theoretical predictions. In contrast, the effects of ambiguity are mixed: participants do not behave as the maximin expected utility model predicts, and their choices differ across parameters. Furthermore, buyout behavior is better explained by the Level-k model than by the standard rational model, indicating systematic deviations from optimal decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验室实验研究第二价格拍卖中竞拍者在买断选项下的行为，重点考察竞争、时间偏好及两者不确定性（模糊性）的影响，发现Level-k模型比标准理性模型更能解释买断行为。
AI.research_question: 在第二价格拍卖含买断选项的情景中，竞争程度、时间偏好以及两者相关的模糊性如何影响竞拍者的买断决策？
AI.motivation: 现实拍卖中买断选项普遍存在（如eBay的“立即购买”），但竞拍者行为常偏离理性预测。作者希望系统检验竞争、时间偏好和模糊性对买断决策的影响，并比较不同行为模型的解释力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标准理性模型（预期效用最大化）、最大最小期望效用模型（处理模糊性）、Level-k模型（有限理性层级推理）。
AI.method: 实验室实验。通过改变竞拍人数（操纵竞争程度）、引入估值衰减率（操纵时间偏好）、以及引入奈特不确定性的参数设定，观察受试者的买断行为。
AI.findings: 1）竞争和时间偏好显著影响买断决策，符合理论预期；2）模糊性的影响不一致，受试者行为不遵循最大最小期望效用模型；3）Level-k模型比标准理性模型更能解释买断行为，说明存在系统性非最优决策偏差。
AI.theory_contributions: 为拍卖理论中买断选项的行为决策机制提供了实验证据；对比了理性模型与有限理性模型的解释力，挑战了标准理性假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为拍卖平台（如eBay）设计买断价格和拍卖规则提供行为洞察；提醒平台考虑竞拍者的有限理性和认知偏差。

title: Outsourcing Extinction: Economic Complexity and the Geography of Biodiversity Loss
affiliations: University of Northern British Columbia, International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) and World Bank Group

detail.title: Outsourcing Extinction: Economic Complexity and the Geography of Biodiversity Loss
detail.abstract: Does the structure of an economy, beyond its level of income, shape biodiversity loss? We relate the Red List Index of aggregate species extinction risk to economic complexity for up to 179 countries between 1993 and 2019. Conditional on income per capita, greater economic complexity raises extinction risk within countries: a one-standard-deviation increase in the Economic Complexity Index lowers the Red List Index by about one to two percent. The result is robust to country and period fixed effects, a long-difference specification, sectoral controls, and instrumental-variables estimation using product-space diversification potential. The mechanism is not domestic. Agricultural land use, forest cover, input intensity, and agricultural productivity do not mediate the relationship, nor are they systematically affected by economic complexity. Instead, complex economies displace biodiversity pressure abroad. In a bilateral matrix of extinction-risk footprints, they are net importers of biodiversity loss, sourcing an increasing share of their footprint from other countries' species. Imports from biome-sharing regions predict subsequent declines in domestic extinction-risk indices, evidence for a range-overlap channel linking foreign habitat conversion to home-country biodiversity outcomes. Economic complexity therefore reorganizes the geography of extinction risk rather than reducing it. Structural transformation does not, on its own, deliver decoupling from biodiversity loss, and conservation policies based on territorial indicators understate the biodiversity cost of complex economies.

AI.tldr: 经济复杂性（而非收入水平）会加剧一国物种灭绝风险，但机制并非通过国内影响，而是通过将生物多样性压力转移至国外——复杂经济是生物多样性损失的净进口国。
AI.research_question: 经济结构（超越收入水平）是否以及如何影响生物多样性丧失？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注收入水平与生物多样性的关系（如环境库兹涅茨曲线），但忽视了经济结构（特别是经济复杂性）的作用。本文旨在检验经济复杂性是否通过全球价值链重新组织生物多样性丧失的地理分布。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济复杂性理论、生物多样性经济学、环境库兹涅茨曲线、生态足迹与范围重叠渠道（range-overlap channel）
AI.method: 面板固定效应模型、长差分估计、工具变量法（利用产品空间多样化潜力作为工具变量），以及双边灭绝风险足迹矩阵分析
AI.findings: (1) 控制人均收入后，经济复杂性每提高一个标准差，红名单指数下降1-2%；(2) 国内机制（农业用地、森林覆盖、投入强度、农业生产力）均不显著；(3) 复杂经济体通过进口将生物多样性压力转移至国外，成为生物多样性损失的净进口国；(4) 从生物群系重叠区域进口可预测本国灭绝风险指数的后续下降，证实范围重叠渠道的存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将经济复杂性引入生物多样性丧失的分析框架，揭示了结构性转型与生物多样性解耦的失败，拓展了环境库兹涅茨曲线的结构性维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示基于领土指标的保护政策低估了复杂经济体的生物多样性成本，呼吁全球价值链视角下的跨国生物多样性治理。

title: Crisis, Compassion, and Capital: The Economics of Global Charitable Giving

detail.title: Crisis, Compassion, and Capital: The Economics of Global Charitable Giving
detail.abstract: Do major crises create new charitable capital, or do they primarily reallocate donor attention? We study this question using the universe of nearly 50,000 projects across 201 countries on GlobalGiving between 2003 and 2025. Exploiting the Russo-Ukrainian war as an exogenous shock to global humanitarian attention, we show that funding to Ukraine-related projects increased dramatically following the war, while funding to non-Ukraine projects declined. The response operates primarily through donor participation rather than donation size, indicating that crises reshape who gives as much as they reshape how much people give. The evidence further suggests that crises generate both new charitable resources and crowd-out of less salient causes, rather than representing either pure additionality or pure substitution. We also develop and test a framework showing that crises reshape charitable giving through both donor preference shifts and narrative competition. The dominant effect is a broad shift toward disaster-response and identifiable-beneficiary appeals, while crowding-out is concentrated in a limited set of narrative frames heavily associated with the crisis. Finally, we document substantial geographic disparities in charitable funding and show that crisis-driven attention amplifies these inequalities, widening funding gaps across regions. Taken together, our findings suggest that charitable giving operates in an attention-constrained market where major crises reshape both the level and distribution of philanthropic capital.

AI.tldr: 利用GlobalGiving上近5万个项目数据，研究俄乌战争这一外生冲击如何影响慈善捐赠，发现危机既创造了新的慈善资源，也导致了对非受关注议题的挤出效应，且主要通过改变捐赠者参与度而非捐赠规模来实现。
AI.research_question: 重大危机会创造新的慈善资本，还是主要重新分配捐赠者的注意力？
AI.motivation: 理解危机对慈善捐赠市场的影响机制，特别是危机是带来新增捐赠资源还是仅仅转移了现有捐赠的流向，对于慈善资源配置效率和社会福利具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 注意力约束市场理论、捐赠者偏好转变、叙事竞争框架
AI.method: 利用GlobalGiving平台2003-2025年间来自201个国家的近5万个项目数据，以俄乌战争作为外生冲击，进行准自然实验分析。
AI.findings: (1)战争后乌克兰项目资金急剧增加，非乌克兰项目资金下降；(2)影响主要通过捐赠者参与度（而非捐赠规模）驱动；(3)危机既创造新资源也挤出低关注度议题，非纯增量或纯替代；(4)主导效应是向灾难响应和可识别受益人诉求的广泛转变，挤出效应集中在与危机高度关联的有限叙事框架中；(5)危机加剧了慈善资金的地理不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了危机通过捐赠者偏好转变和叙事竞争双重机制重塑慈善捐赠的理论框架；揭示了注意力约束在慈善市场中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为慈善平台、非营利组织和政策制定者理解危机情境下的捐赠动态提供了实证依据，提示需关注危机对非受关注地区和议题的潜在挤出效应及其引发的地理不平等。

title: Risk and Illiquidity Premia in the Cross Section of OTC Assets
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University - Carey Business School and

detail.title: Risk and Illiquidity Premia in the Cross Section of OTC Assets

declarations.funderStatement: Semih Uslu acknowledges the General Research Support Fund Award from the Johns Hopkins Carey Business School.

detail.abstract: We develop a dynamic model of a multi-asset over-the-counter (OTC) market that operates via search and bargaining, and test its implications for illiquidity premia and market liquidity in the cross section of assets. Investors can trade each asset bilaterally subject to search frictions or trade an entire portfolio with specialized dealers by paying a fixed cost. General-equilibrium effects shape the cross section of liquidity and asset returns: assets with higher exposure to search frictions have higher return premia, lower trade volume, and higher price dispersion, and alleviating the search frictions in one asset can affect different empirical measures of other assets' liquidity in opposite directions. Using transaction-level data from the US corporate bond market and proxying for the inverse of search frictions with dealer centrality, we find substantial empirical support for our theory's implications, including its cross-asset mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个多资产场外交易市场的动态搜索与议价模型，研究了流动性溢价和市场流动性的横截面差异，并利用美国公司债交易数据验证了理论预测。
AI.research_question: 场外交易市场中，资产的流动性如何在横截面上影响其回报溢价和市场流动性？不同资产之间的流动性如何相互影响？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多集中于单一资产或同质化市场，缺乏对多资产OTC市场中流动性横截面差异及其一般均衡效应的系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 搜索摩擦理论、议价理论、一般均衡资产定价框架
AI.method: 构建动态多资产OTC市场搜索与议价模型，利用美国公司债交易数据进行实证检验，以交易商中心度作为搜索摩擦逆代理变量。
AI.findings: 搜索摩擦暴露越高的资产，回报溢价越高、交易量越低、价格离散度越高；缓解某一资产的搜索摩擦可能对其他资产流动性的不同衡量指标产生相反影响；实证数据支持上述理论预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在多资产OTC市场框架下系统分析流动性横截面的决定机制，揭示了一般均衡中资产间流动性溢出效应的非单调性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和市场参与者理解OTC市场流动性风险及其传导机制提供了理论依据和实证证据，有助于优化市场设计和风险管理。

title: The Euro Area Bank Lending Channel of Monetary Policy
affiliations: University of Turin - Collegio Carlo Alberto and Independent

detail.title: The Euro Area Bank Lending Channel of Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: The bank lending channel is a cornerstone of monetary policy transmission in the Euro area, where bank credit constitutes the primary source of external finance for firms and households. This paper examines the transmission of monetary policy through this channel using a medium-scale Bayesian Structural Vector Autoregression (BSVAR) model estimated over 2006Q1-2024Q2, identified via sign restrictions normalised to a 25-basis-point contractionary shock. Robustness is assessed via a large Factor-Augmented VAR (FAVAR) model and local projections using the Jarociński and Karadi (2020) high-frequency monetary policy (MP) and central bank information (CBI) shock series. The results confirm the presence of the bank lending channel: a contractionary monetary policy shock contracts real activity and inflation, raises bank loan rates, increases financial volatility, and tightens credit conditions, with effects peaking within four to six quarters. The MP shock accounts for approximately 6-8 percent of the forecast error variance of output and loan rates at medium-term horizons. The CBI shock produces distinctly weaker real effects, underscoring the empirical importance of separating pure rate decisions from central bank signaling.

AI.tldr: 本文采用中尺度贝叶斯结构向量自回归（BSVAR）模型，结合因子增广VAR（FAVAR）和局部投影方法，证实了欧元区银行信贷渠道的存在：紧缩性货币政策冲击会在4-6个季度内抑制实际经济活动与通胀、抬高贷款利率、加剧金融波动并收紧信贷条件，其中货币政策冲击解释了中期内产出和贷款利率约6-8%的预测误差方差，而央行信息冲击的实际效应明显更弱，凸显了区分纯利率决策与央行信号的重要性。
AI.research_question: 欧元区货币政策是否通过银行信贷渠道传导？货币政策和央行信息冲击对宏观经济和金融变量的影响有何不同？
AI.motivation: 银行信贷是欧元区企业和家庭外部融资的主要来源，银行信贷渠道是货币政策传导的基石。准确识别和量化该渠道的传导效应，对理解欧元区货币政策传导机制至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行信贷渠道理论；货币政策传导机制；央行信息效应。
AI.method: 中尺度贝叶斯结构向量自回归（BSVAR）模型，通过符号约束识别，标准化为25个基点的紧缩性冲击；使用因子增广VAR（FAVAR）模型和局部投影法（Jarociński & Karadi, 2020高频货币政策和央行信息冲击序列）进行稳健性检验。样本期为2006Q1-2024Q2。
AI.findings: 紧缩性货币政策冲击会抑制实际产出和通胀、提高银行贷款利率、增加金融波动性并收紧信贷条件，效应在4-6个季度达到峰值；货币政策冲击解释了中期内产出和贷款利率约6-8%的预测误差方差；央行信息冲击的实际效应明显弱于纯货币政策冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 为欧元区银行信贷渠道的存在提供了基于现代时间序列方法的实证证据；明确了区分纯货币政策冲击与央行信息冲击在分析货币政策传导中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧元区（尤其是欧洲央行）货币政策制定和沟通策略提供了定量参考依据，有助于政策制定者更精准地评估不同政策操作和信号对实体经济的传导效果。

title: Subjective Risk Premia in Bond and FX Markets
affiliations: Queen Mary University of London - School of Economics and Finance and The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - CUHK Business School

detail.title: Subjective Risk Premia in Bond and FX Markets
detail.abstract: Using a thirty-year monthly panel of professional forecasts across ten countries, we measure subjective bond and currency risk premia. Subjective bond premia are on average negative; currency premia follow the carry-trade ordering; and yield forecast errors are systematically negative while exchange rate errors are unbiased. Subjective bond premia vary counter-cyclically with expected growth, while subjective currency premia are explained by foreign growth expectations, but only in the cross section. An international habit-formation model rationalizes these patterns: a moderate positive distortion in beliefs about consumption growth drives subjective risk premia across international markets through the surplus-consumption channel.

AI.tldr: 本文利用十个国家三十年的月度专业预测面板数据，测量主观债券和货币风险溢价。研究发现：主观债券溢价平均为负；货币溢价遵循利差交易排序；债券收益率预测误差系统为负，而汇率预测误差无偏。主观债券溢价与预期增长呈逆周期变化，主观货币溢价仅横截面上受外国增长预期解释。一个国际习惯形成模型通过剩余消费渠道解释了这些模式。
AI.research_question: 如何测量并解释国际金融市场中的主观债券和货币风险溢价？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多从客观风险溢价角度分析，但主观风险溢价（基于专业预测者的实际预期）的研究较少，且跨国比较不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际习惯形成模型（habit-formation model），通过剩余消费（surplus-consumption）渠道解释主观风险溢价模式。
AI.method: 使用十个国家三十年的月度专业预测面板数据，分析主观风险溢价、预测误差，并结合国际习惯形成模型进行理论解释。
AI.findings: 1. 主观债券溢价平均为负；2. 货币溢价遵循利差交易排序；3. 债券收益率预测误差系统为负，汇率预测误差无偏；4. 主观债券溢价与预期增长逆周期相关；5. 主观货币溢价仅横截面上受外国增长预期解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统度量多国主观债券和货币风险溢价；2. 发现债券与货币风险溢价的不同动态特征；3. 用国际习惯形成模型统一解释这些跨国异象。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者理解国际资产定价中的预期偏差提供实证依据；2. 对央行和监管机构评估市场预期与风险定价具有参考价值；3. 揭示利差交易策略背后的主观预期因素。

title: Women's Commuting After Childbirth: Evidence from U.S. Panel Data
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Women's Commuting After Childbirth: Evidence from U.S. Panel Data
detail.abstract: Post-childbirth commute burden is a potential source for disparity in labor market experience and earnings between men and women. A recent notable example is \cite{Bütikofer2025}, who document that the commuting patterns of Norwegian parents diverge substantially and persistently after their first childbirth, with mothers reducing commuting distance by 19 kilometers compared to 10 kilometers for fathers. We extend this line of inquiry using U.S. data from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics that cover two distinct periods: 1970--1986 and 2011--2019. We find patterns that differ in important ways from the Norwegian experience. While U.S. mothers exit the labor force at substantially higher rates than fathers following childbirth, mothers who remain employed show little change in commuting time or distance relative to their pre-birth patterns or to fathers---a robust finding across four decades and across both time and distance measures of commute. These contrasting patterns call for more cross-country research on post-childbirth commute changes in both time and distance.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用美国1970-1986和2011-2019两阶段的面板数据，发现美国母亲在生育后虽退出劳动力市场的比例远高于父亲，但继续就业的母亲通勤时间或距离几乎没有变化，这与挪威研究中父母通勤模式在生育后显著分化的结果形成鲜明对比，呼吁更多跨国比较研究。
AI.research_question: 孩子出生后，美国父母在通勤时间与距离上的变化模式是否与挪威的发现一致？
AI.motivation: 挪威研究（Bütikofer等，2025）发现生育后父母通勤模式显著分化（母亲减少19公里，父亲仅10公里），但这种模式是否具有跨国家、跨时期的普适性尚不清楚。美国作为劳动力市场性别不平等显著的发达国家，提供了重要的比较案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生育后通勤负担的性别差异理论、劳动力市场性别不平等理论、跨国比较视角
AI.method: 使用美国收入动态追踪调查（PSID）1970-1986和2011-2019两个时期的数据，比较生育前后父母通勤时间与距离的变化，并与挪威研究结果进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 美国母亲在生育后退出劳动力市场的比率远高于父亲，但继续就业的母亲通勤时间或距离几乎没有变化（相对于生育前模式或父亲而言）。这一发现在四个跨度中、在时间和距离两种通勤度量下均稳健。这与挪威父母通勤模式显著分化的结果形成鲜明对比。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了生育后通勤变化的性别差异并非普适性现象，而具有显著的跨国异质性，挑战了将单一国家结论一般化的倾向，为理解劳动力市场性别不平等的制度性根源提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者注意，不同国家因劳动力市场结构、家庭政策、通勤基础设施等差异，生育对职业性别差距的影响机制可能截然不同，跨国政策借鉴需谨慎。

title: Central Bank Communication Graphs for Bank of England and Federal Reserve Documents, 1998-2026
affiliations: Middle East Technical University

detail.title: Central Bank Communication Graphs for Bank of England and Federal Reserve Documents, 1998-2026
detail.abstract: This Data Descriptor presents a temporal semantic graph dataset derived from public Bank of England and Federal Reserve communications released between 1998 and 2026. The dataset represents 2,872 valid documents as graph snapshots in the Monetary Communication Graph for mat, with 2,872 document container nodes, 24,010 semantic nodes, and 24,185 typed semantic edges. Unlike flat-text corpora, the format separates recurring policy-relevant communication channels, cited evidence, document-grounded inference, market-relevance fields, and within document semantic relations. The release includes model-ready document, node, and edge tables; 51,067 text embeddings; fixed semantic slot mappings for temporal modelling; schema definitions; prompts; validation outputs; helper scripts; figures; and file manifests with check sums. The dataset supports reusable research on central-bank communication, monetary-policy discourse, market-expectation formation, temporal semantic graphs, representation learning, and dynamic graph modelling.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于1998-2026年英国央行和美联储公开沟通文件的时间语义图数据集，包含2,872份文档、24,010个语义节点和24,185条语义边，支持央行沟通、货币政策话语、市场预期形成等领域的可重复研究。
AI.research_question: 如何将央行公开沟通文本结构化为时间语义图数据集，以支持货币政策沟通的动态建模与可重复研究？
AI.motivation: 现有央行沟通研究多基于扁平文本语料，难以捕捉政策相关沟通渠道、引用证据、文档推理、市场相关字段及文档内语义关系等结构化信息，缺乏可直接用于动态图建模的标准化数据集。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间语义图建模、央行沟通理论、市场预期形成理论、表征学习
AI.method: 从英国央行和美联储1998-2026年公开沟通文件中提取语义节点和边，构建Monetary Communication Graph格式的时间语义图快照，生成文档、节点、边表格及文本嵌入等标准化数据资源。
AI.findings: 构建了包含2,872个文档容器节点、24,010个语义节点、24,185条语义边的数据集，提供了51,067个文本嵌入、固定语义槽映射、模式定义、提示词、验证输出等完整配套资源。
AI.theory_contributions: 为央行沟通研究与时间语义图建模提供了可直接复用的标准化数据结构，弥合了自然语言处理与货币政策研究之间的方法论鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 数据集及其配套资源（嵌入、模式定义、验证脚本等）可直接支持央行沟通分析、货币政策话语追踪、市场预期建模、表征学习与动态图建模等应用场景。

title: Memorized but Not Realized: Frontier Language Models Precisely Recall Financial Fundamentals, but It Does Not Become Trading Skill
affiliations: University of Geneva

detail.title: Memorized but Not Realized: Frontier Language Models Precisely Recall Financial Fundamentals, but It Does Not Become Trading Skill

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, their data, or animal subjects. It uses firm-level financial-market data and publicly released language models only; ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares no competing interests. The research was conducted independently; it was not funded by, and does not rely on the proprietary data or systems of, any commercial trading entity.

detail.abstract: LLM "AI-trading" benchmarks are routinely scored by replaying historical markets, raising a contamination concern: a model that has memorized an asset's realized outcome cannot generate honest out-of-sample skill, so backtest performance may be recall rather than foresight. We build a white-box-to-black-box validated leakage instrument and use it to ask the decision-relevant question prior work leaves open: does memorization capacity actually transmit to trading decisions? We report a dissociation. Capacity is large, precise, and universal: across 16 open models (10 vendors) and three commercial APIs, models prefer the realized revenue over magnitude-matched (±15%) counterfactuals at 0.23–0.81 (chance 0.20) and freely generate the figure within 10% for up to 89% of famous firm-years, while no-leak chronologically-consistent baselines sit at chance. Recall is cutoff-bounded: exploiting the models' different training cutoffs, it collapses to chance for facts dated after a model's cutoff (within-model t = −6.6, 18 of 19 models), the design-based signature of memorization rather than estimation. Applied to the realized return itself — the variable a backtest fears — recall is at chance with no cutoff signature: these models memorize fundamentals, not prices. Realization, by contrast, is null across five independent tests, including a cross-sectional ranking task (N ≈ 5,700 per model) and a realistic StockBench-style backtest over six open and frontier-API agents; an apparent agentic signal (+9.9pp, t = 4.07) is shown to be a firm-prominence confound that vanishes under firm fixed effects (β = −0.018). A pre-registered, dependence-corrected power analysis bounds any residual post-cutoff skill: on a ≈2,000-name post-cutoff universe the minimum detectable mean |IC| is ≈0.012–0.016, below the 0.02–0.05 band where real cross-sectional strategies operate. The contribution is a validated leakage instrument, an identification result showing why memorization is invisible to any pre-cutoff backtest, and the finding that, for the signals we test, LLM memorization of the market does not become measurable market skill.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大规模语言模型（LLM）存在对历史市场数据的记忆（泄漏），但这种记忆主要停留在对基本面事实的回忆层面，并未转化为实际的交易能力——模型记住了公司的收入数据，却无法预测股价回报，在任何后截断日期（post-cutoff）的测试中交易表现均回归随机水平。
AI.research_question: LLM对历史市场数据的记忆（memorization）是否会传导至实际交易决策，即回测中的表现究竟是"回忆"还是"预见"？
AI.motivation: 现有LLM交易回测中普遍使用历史市场数据，存在数据污染（contamination）风险——模型若已记住资产的真实结果，则无法产生诚实的样本外能力。已有研究未回答决策相关的关键问题：记忆能力是否真的转化为交易决策？
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于记忆泄漏（memorization leakage）与无样本外能力（no out-of-sample skill）的识别框架，利用模型训练截断日期（cutoff date）作为设计基准来区分记忆与真实估计。
AI.method: 构建白盒至黑盒验证的泄漏检测工具（leakage instrument），对16个开源模型（10个供应商）及3个商业API进行测试；设计后截断日期（post-cutoff）的对照组；进行五个独立的交易能力测试，包括横截面排序任务（N≈5,700/模型）和StockBench风格回测；使用预注册的、依赖校正的统计功效分析。
AI.findings: （1）模型记忆能力大、精确且普遍：模型在0.23–0.81的概率下偏好真实收入数据（随机为0.20），可高达89%的著名公司年份内自由生成接近10%以内的数字；（2）记忆具有截断边界：对于模型训练截断日期之后的事实，记忆崩塌至随机水平（within-model t=−6.6，18/19个模型）；（3）对实际回报（realized return）的记忆处于随机水平，无截断效应——模型记住的是基本面，而非价格；（4）五个独立测试中交易信号均为空，一个看似显著的信号（+9.9pp, t=4.07）实为公司显著性混杂，在固定效应下消失（β=−0.018）；（5）功效分析表明后截断技能的上界极小（平均|IC|≈0.012–0.016），低于实际横截面策略的运作区间（0.02–0.05）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了经验验证的泄漏检测工具；给出了"为什么记忆在任何前截断（pre-cutoff）回测中不可见"的识别结果；证明LLM对市场的记忆并未转化为可测量的市场技能。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融市场中使用LLM进行交易回测的研究者和从业者提供了警惕数据污染的方法论工具与证据；提醒从业者区分"模型记住了什么"与"模型能预测什么"之间的本质差异。

title: News Duration Risk and Asset Prices

detail.title: News Duration Risk and Asset Prices
detail.abstract: This paper studies asset pricing when investors observe the size and frequency of aggregate shocks but disagree about their duration. Motivated by survey evidence that professional forecasters differ in the speed at which they expect output shocks to dissipate, I develop a continuous-time endowment economy in which agents agree on the probabilities and magnitudes of transitory news shocks but hold different priors over their decay rate. A shock therefore starts a learning episode: its impact is observed immediately, while its persistence is revealed only through the subsequent recovery path. The equilibrium separates size and probability risks from news-duration risk. Risk sharing is likelihood-weighted, and the stochastic discount factor depends on both aggregate marginal utility and the consumption-weighted distribution of beliefs. Duration learning reallocates consumption and wealth, changes the beliefs of the marginal investor, and moves discount rates, risk premia, and hedging demands. In a three-decay-rate implementation, persistent-duration evidence raises the relevance of future cash-flow consequences and strengthens predictability, whereas evidence of rapid dissipation compresses compensation by shortening the expected life of the shock. These effects appear in valuation ratios, derivative positions, and bond and equity yields. The analysis shows that news-duration risk is a distinct asset-pricing force: even when investors agree on what happened, disagreement about how long it will matter is priced.

AI.tldr: 本文研究投资者在观察到宏观经济冲击的规模和频率、但对冲击持续时间存在意见分歧时的资产定价问题。通过构建连续时间禀赋经济模型，发现"新闻-持续时间风险"是一个独立的资产定价因子：即便投资者对"发生了什么"意见一致，对"它会持续多久"的分歧也会被定价。
AI.research_question: 当投资者观察到总冲击的规模和频率、但对冲击的持续时间（衰减速度）存在意见分歧时，资产价格如何形成？
AI.motivation: 专业预测者对产出冲击消散速度的预期存在系统性差异（调查证据），但现有资产定价模型未充分研究对冲击"持续时间"的分歧如何独立于对冲击"发生"的分歧影响资产价格。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间禀赋经济模型；学习（Learning）框架；异质性信念（Heterogeneous Beliefs）；随机贴现因子（SDF）；风险分担（Risk Sharing）
AI.method: 理论建模：构建连续时间一般均衡模型，代理人同意冲击的概率和大小，但对衰减率持有不同先验。冲击发生后，其影响立即被观测，但持久性通过后续恢复路径被逐步揭示。
AI.findings: (1) 均衡将规模/概率风险与新闻-持续时间风险分离；(2) 风险分担是似然加权的，SDF取决于总边际效用和消费加权的信念分布；(3) 持续时间学习会重新配置消费和财富、改变边际投资者的信念、移动贴现率、风险溢价和对冲需求；(4) 在三衰减率设定中，持续持久性证据增强未来现金流的相关性和可预测性，快速消散证据压缩补偿；(5) 新闻-持续时间风险是一个独立的定价力量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并证明了"新闻-持续时间风险"（news-duration risk）是一个区别于传统冲击规模/概率风险的独立资产定价因子，丰富了异质性信念和学习的资产定价理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解估值比率、衍生品头寸以及债券和股票收益率中的定价现象提供了新视角；对投资者基于冲击持续时间分歧进行对冲和组合管理具有指导意义。

title: Ownership Structure and Bank Stability: Evidence from the 2023 Banking Crisis
affiliations: University of North Texas and University of Georgia - Department of Finance

detail.title: Ownership Structure and Bank Stability: Evidence from the 2023 Banking Crisis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: We examine how the composition of institutional and insider ownership relates to bank vulnerability during the March 2023 banking crisis. Using 463 publicly traded U.S. banks, we find that higher aggregate institutional ownership is associated with worse crisis-period returns, but that this relation masks heterogeneity across investor types. Hedge fund ownership is associated with exposure to higherrisk bank characteristics, consistent with risk selection, and this relation survives across subsamples and specifications. Investment advisor ownership predicts larger short-term declines, consistent with pricepressure dynamics, although this relation is weaker and is supported primarily in the full cross-section rather than in a narrower subsample of larger banks for which more detailed data are available. We find no evidence of pre-crisis insider or institutional exit from banks that subsequently experienced the largest crisis-period declines, alleviating the concern that ownership at the onset of the crisis reflects anticipatory portfolio choices by informed investors. This inference is stronger for insiders than for institutions, since quarterly 13F filings limit our ability to observe late-window institutional trading. Moreover, insider ownership attenuates the negative hedge fund-return relation, consistent with managerial equity stakes dampening the risk-taking pressures associated with hedge fund ownership. These associations are not absorbed by observable proxies for uninsured-deposit exposure and unrealized securities losses. Overall, institutional ownership composition contains information about crisis-period bank performance that the aggregate level alone does not reveal.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2023年3月银行业危机期间，机构投资者和内部人持股构成如何影响银行脆弱性。发现对冲基金持股与高风险银行特征相关（风险选择），投资顾问持股预测短期更大跌幅（价格压力），而内部人持股缓解了对冲基金持股带来的负面回报关系。
AI.research_question: 2023年3月银行业危机期间，机构投资者和内部人持股构成如何影响银行脆弱性？不同投资者类型的持股对银行危机期表现有何差异？
AI.motivation: 2023年3月美国区域性银行危机（硅谷银行、签名银行等倒闭）凸显了银行脆弱性问题。此前文献多关注银行自身特征（如未实现亏损、未保险存款），但对股权结构如何影响危机期银行表现知之甚少，尤其是机构持股的异质性效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险选择假说（对冲基金倾向于持有高风险银行）、价格压力假说（投资顾问持股导致短期抛售压力）、内部人持股抑制风险承担假说（管理层持股缓解对冲基金风险压力）、信息优势/提前退出假说（内部人或机构是否在危机前提前撤资）。
AI.method: 使用463家美国上市银行数据，将机构持股细分为对冲基金、投资顾问等类型，进行横截面回归分析，并控制银行特征（未保险存款敞口、未实现证券损失等）。
AI.findings: （1）总机构持股越高，危机期回报越差，但这一关系掩盖了投资者类型间的异质性；（2）对冲基金持股与高风险银行特征相关（风险选择），该效应在各子样本中稳健；（3）投资顾问持股预测短期更大跌幅（价格压力），但仅在全体本中显著；（4）未发现危机前内部人或机构从跌幅最大银行中提前退出的证据；（5）内部人持股缓解了对冲基金持股与回报的负面关系；（6）上述关联不能被未保险存款敞口和未实现证券损失所吸收。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了机构持股构成对银行危机期表现的异质性影响，区分了风险选择机制（对冲基金）与价格压力机制（投资顾问）；发现内部人持股的治理作用——缓解对冲基金带来的风险承担压力；表明仅看总机构持股会遗漏重要信息。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者和投资者提供了理解银行脆弱性的新视角：不仅应关注银行资产负债表特征，还应关注其股权结构，尤其是机构投资者的构成；提示监管者对高对冲基金持股、低内部人持股的银行应加强关注；为银行管理层和董事会优化股权结构以增强危机韧性提供参考。

title: Fixed Deep Residual Networks with Multi-Objective Proximal Policy Optimization for Adaptive Trading

detail.title: Fixed Deep Residual Networks with Multi-Objective Proximal Policy Optimization for Adaptive Trading
detail.abstract: Financial markets are highly noisy and unpredictable. Trading strategies are required to simultaneously account for short-term price fluctuations and long-term structural regimes. Furthermore, developing a quantitative system that balances multiple conflicting objectives, such as maximizing profit while minimizing downside risk, according to shifting preferences remains a significant challenge. To address these limitations, we propose an adaptive trading framework that integrates a Deep Residual Network (DRN) with a single multi-objective Reinforcement Learning (RL) model. Operating over raw technical indicators, our DRN architecture utilizes residual skip connections to impose a structured, nonlinear geometric transformation on the raw technical indicator matrix, producing stable 32-dimensional latent embeddings that are held fixed throughout the reinforcement learning optimization phase. Rather than training a computationally heavy concatenation of multiple discrete RL networks, our system trains a single unified agent directly on dynamic objective sets to learn the continuous relationship between different preference combinations and the fixed DRN market representations. Experimental results demonstrate that this pipeline delivers steadier, more robust trading performance along the Pareto-optimal frontier, offering a highly scalable and adaptive alternative to traditional multi-network systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将深度残差网络（DRN）与单目标多目标强化学习（RL）模型集成的自适应交易框架，通过在固定DRN嵌入上训练统一RL智能体，实现不同偏好组合下的帕累托最优交易策略，性能优于传统多网络系统。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够在高噪声金融市场中同时处理短期价格波动与长期结构性状态，并依据动态偏好平衡利润最大化与下行风险等多重冲突目标的量化交易系统？
AI.motivation: 金融市场高度噪声化且不可预测，现有交易策略难以同时兼顾短期波动与长期结构；同时，传统多网络强化学习系统计算成本高，且难以在连续偏好空间中灵活平衡多目标（如收益与风险）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度残差网络（DRN）、多目标强化学习（Multi-objective Reinforcement Learning）、帕累托最优前沿（Pareto-optimal frontier）
AI.method: 先利用DRN对原始技术指标矩阵进行结构化非线性几何变换，提取稳定的32维潜在嵌入（该嵌入在RL阶段固定不动）；再训练单个统一的多目标RL智能体，直接在动态目标集上学习不同偏好组合与固定DRN市场表征之间的连续映射关系。
AI.findings: 该流水线在帕累托最优前沿上实现了更稳定、更鲁棒的交易表现，相比传统多网络系统具有更高的可扩展性和适应性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出将DRN固定嵌入与单智能体多目标RL相结合的新范式，避免了训练多个离散RL网络的高计算成本，理论上验证了连续偏好空间下统一建模的可行性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为量化交易提供了一种高度可扩展、自适应且计算高效的端到端框架，能够在不同风险偏好下灵活平衡收益与风险，具有实际部署价值。

title: Going Local: Decentralization, Bureaucratic Capacity and Public Spending Efficiency
affiliations: Sapienza University of Rome - Department of Social Sciences and Economics and

detail.title: Going Local: Decentralization, Bureaucratic Capacity and Public Spending Efficiency
detail.abstract: Decentralization reforms are typically justified on efficiency grounds, yet their distributional consequences remain poorly understood. We show that a uniform administrative decentralization reform can generate aggregate efficiency gains while simultaneously widening territorial disparities, depending on the pre-existing bureaucratic capacity of local governments. Exploiting spatial variation in the implementation of a major Italian constitutional reform of 2001 through a matched difference-indifferences design and data covering 1998-2007, we document significant average efficiency gains. However, aggregate gains mask a distributional divide: highcapacity municipalities achieve efficiency improvements through cost optimization, maintaining their pre-reform growth trajectory, while low-capacity municipalities concentrate efforts on visible short-term gains and experience an average income loss of approximately 116 per capita. We identify four mechanisms driving this divergence: enhanced fiscal accountability through greater reliance on local taxation, a strategic shift toward income taxation paired with greater leniency in tax collection among low-capacity municipalities, incumbents' re-election incentives, and local governments' responsiveness to citizens' expressed preferences for decentralization. This study provides important policy implications for understanding distributional consequences of decentralization processes and inform their optimal design.

AI.tldr: 意大利2001年宪法改革的分权政策在提高整体效率的同时，因地方政府原有行政能力差异而加剧了地区不平等：高能力城市通过成本优化实现效率提升，低能力城市则追求短期可见收益，导致人均收入损失约116欧元。
AI.research_question: 行政分权改革如何在产生总体效率提升的同时，影响地区间的分配不平等？
AI.motivation: 分权改革通常以效率为理由推进，但其分配效应尚不明确，理解这一问题对改革的最优设计至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 官僚能力理论、财政问责理论、政治激励理论、公民偏好响应理论
AI.method: 利用意大利2001年宪法改革的空间变异，采用匹配双重差分方法，使用1998-2007年数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 分权改革带来平均效率提升，但低能力城市人均收入损失约116欧元；高能力城市通过成本优化维持原有增长轨迹，低能力城市追求短期可见收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了分权改革效率与公平之间的权衡机制，提出官僚能力是决定分权效果的关键调节变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为分权改革的设计提供政策建议，强调需考虑地方政府行政能力差异，避免改革加剧地区不平等。

title: Data Transport, AI, and Growth
affiliations: University of South Carolina, Stanford University - Hoover Institution and Duke University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Data Transport, AI, and Growth
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence services require model-building and computation (model/compute) together with data transport, the technical and legal work that makes usable data available to computing, storage, monitoring, and learning systems. We develop an endogenous-growth model in which firms invest in both. Because data are nonrival, data-transport barriers create a double wedge: they raise current delivery costs and reduce data available for future innovation. Model/compute innovation alone generally cannot sustain growth when data-delivery costs remain incompressible; data-transport innovation restores balanced growth. Regulations that fragment data use across agencies or jurisdictions reduce growth, while trust-enhancing safeguards can raise it.

AI.tldr: 本文构建内生增长模型，研究AI服务中模型/计算创新与数据运输创新的平衡增长路径，发现数据运输壁垒会形成双重楔子效应，仅靠模型/计算创新无法维持增长，必须依赖数据运输创新。数据碎片化监管降低增长，而信任增强机制可促进增长。
AI.research_question: 在人工智能服务中，模型/计算创新与数据运输创新如何共同影响经济增长？数据运输壁垒和监管政策对增长有何影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注AI中的模型和计算创新，但忽略了数据运输（使数据可供计算、存储、监控和学习系统使用的技术和法律工作）的重要性。由于数据具有非竞争性，数据运输障碍可能对经济增长产生独特的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生增长模型，将数据视为非竞争性投入品，区分模型/计算创新与数据运输创新两类投资，分析数据运输壁垒产生的"双重楔子"效应。
AI.method: 理论建模，构建内生增长模型进行均衡分析。
AI.findings: （1）数据运输壁垒产生双重楔子：提高当前交付成本并减少可用于未来创新的数据；（2）当数据交付成本不可压缩时，仅靠模型/计算创新无法维持增长；（3）数据运输创新可以恢复平衡增长；（4）跨机构或跨辖区碎片化数据使用监管会降低增长；（5）信任增强的保障措施可以提高增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数据运输概念纳入内生增长理论，揭示了数据非竞争性导致的双重楔子机制，区分了模型/计算创新与数据运输创新的不同增长效应，为AI时代的增长理论提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI基础设施投资、数据监管政策（特别是数据碎片化问题）和信任机制设计提供理论指导，提示政策制定者应重视数据运输创新并减少跨辖区数据壁垒。

title: Randomized Neural Networks for estimation of exposure profiles and Credit Valuation Adjustment (CVA) for American Equity Options
affiliations: University of Warsaw,  and University of Warsaw - Faculty of Economic Sciences

detail.title: Randomized Neural Networks for estimation of exposure profiles and Credit Valuation Adjustment (CVA) for American Equity Options
detail.abstract: This thesis studies the use of randomized neural networks for the estimation of exposure profiles and unilateral CVA of American options within a Monte Carlo framework. The analysis is carried out separately under both Black-Scholes and Heston dynamics, combining American option valuation, expected exposure and potential future exposure estimation, and unilateral CVA calculation with portfolio netting effects. The numerical experiment compares this approach with the classical Least-Squares Monte Carlo (LSM) used as a benchmark in both low-dimensional single-asset and high-dimensional multiasset scenarios, and also includes a path convergence test and a sensitivity analysis. The results show that the randomized feedforward neural network approach preserves convergence to the LSM benchmark when it is extended from pricing to exposure and CVA estimation, while its main advantage appears in high-dimensional problems, where it scales more efficiently and leads to lower computational cost. These results support the use of randomized neural networks as a useful alternative for exposure and CVA estimation in high-dimensional American-style options.

AI.tldr: 本文研究使用随机神经网络在蒙特卡罗框架下估计美式期权的风险暴露和信用估值调整（CVA），发现该方法在高维问题中比经典最小二乘蒙特卡罗（LSM）更高效且计算成本更低。
AI.research_question: 随机神经网络能否有效用于美式期权的风险暴露和CVA估计，并在高维问题中优于传统LSM方法？
AI.motivation: 高维美式期权的风险暴露和CVA计算传统上依赖LSM方法，但该方法在高维场景下计算效率较低。随机神经网络作为一种更高效的替代方案，其在这方面的适用性尚未得到充分验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机神经网络（Randomized Neural Networks）、Black-Scholes模型、Heston模型、最小二乘蒙特卡罗（LSM）方法、期望暴露（EE）、潜在未来暴露（PFE）、信用估值调整（CVA）、组合净额结算效应。
AI.method: 在Black-Scholes和Heston两种动力学下，分别对低维单资产和高维多资产的美式期权进行数值实验，将随机神经网络方法与LSM基准进行对比，并进行了路径收敛性检验和敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 随机前馈神经网络方法在从定价扩展到风险暴露和CVA估计时保持了与LSM基准的收敛性；其主要优势体现在高维问题中，具有更高的扩展效率和更低的计算成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了随机神经网络在高维美式期权风险暴露和CVA估计中的有效性，拓展了该方法在金融衍生品风险管理中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高维美式期权的风险暴露和CVA计算提供了一种计算成本更低的替代方案，有助于金融机构在实际业务中更高效地进行信用风险管理。

title: The Heterogeneous Impact of the Energy Transition
affiliations: University of Turin - Collegio Carlo Alberto,  and University College Cork

detail.title: The Heterogeneous Impact of the Energy Transition

declarations.funderStatement: Matteo Bondesan acknowledges financial support under the National Recovery and Resilience Plan (NRRP), Mission 4, Component 2, Investment 1.1, Call for tender No. 1409 published on 14.9.2022 by the Italian Ministry of University and Research (MUR), funded by the European Union – NextGenerationEU– Project Title ”Measuring, managing and hedging indirect climate-transition risks” – CUP P20228CHNL - Grant Assignment Decree No. 1376 adopted on 01/09/2023 by the Italian Ministry of University and Research (MUR).

detail.abstract: The energy transition is inflationary in the short run and deflationary in the long run, with uneven intergenerational effects. We develop a climate OLG model extending Diamond (1965) to a dual-sector economy with a brown fossil-fuel sector and a green renewable sector. A carbon tax shifts capital and labour toward the more capital-intensive green sector, while a convex damage function maps accumulated atmospheric carbon into output losses and raises the optimal Pigouvian tax over time. The transition is inflationary at first because the tax passes through into brown-sector prices, but becomes deflationary in the long run as learning-by-doing boosts green productivity. The tax burdens older cohorts through lower savings returns, whereas younger cohorts face lower wages but benefit from reduced future climate damages. A revenue-neutral transfer that directs more than half of revenues to the elderly cohort equalises welfare impacts. We derive a Green Golden Rule showing that efficient climate policy requires carbon taxation combined with intergenerational transfers.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含棕色（化石燃料）和绿色（可再生能源）两部门的气候OLG模型，研究发现碳税在短期内具有通胀效应，长期则因绿色部门的学习效应而转为通缩；碳税对代际影响不均，通过对老年人的转移支付可实现福利均等化。
AI.research_question: 能源转型如何影响通胀动态？碳税对不同代际的福利效应如何？如何通过政策设计实现代际公平？
AI.motivation: 能源转型存在短期通胀与长期通缩的不对称效应，且碳税对老年代和年轻代的福利影响不均，现有研究缺乏一个统一的代际一般均衡框架来分析这一动态过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Diamond (1965)的OLG模型扩展为两部门经济模型，结合碳税传导机制、凸性气候损害函数、绿色部门干中学效应，以及Green Golden Rule最优气候政策规则。
AI.method: 理论建模，构建包含棕色部门与绿色部门的代际交叠（OLG）一般均衡模型，通过模型推导分析碳税与转移支付的动态效应。
AI.findings: (1) 碳税短期推高棕色部门价格导致通胀，长期因绿色部门干中学提升生产率转为通缩；(2) 老年代遭受储蓄回报下降的损失，年轻代面临工资下降但受益于未来气候损害减轻；(3) 将超过一半的碳税收入转移给老年人可均等化代际福利；(4) 最优气候政策需结合碳税与代际转移支付。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Green Golden Rule，将气候政策与代际公平纳入统一框架，丰富了OLG模型在环境经济学中的应用，揭示了碳税通胀-通缩双重动态的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计碳税与代际转移支付组合政策提供了理论依据，特别是如何配置碳税收入以实现代际福利均等化的具体比例指引。

title: NSP-02: Hyperbolic Cognitive Memory with Ricci-adaptive Curvature Nexus Sovereign Physics & AGI

detail.title: NSP-02: Hyperbolic Cognitive Memory with Ricci-adaptive Curvature Nexus Sovereign Physics & AGI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the sole researcher and founder of Pietarien. The research presented was conducted independently as part of Pietarien's internal R&D and innovation activities. There are no other financial or personal relationships with other people or organizations that could be perceived to have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research focuses on computational architectures, AI systems, and theoretical innovation frameworks. It does not involve human participants, patient data, or case studies requiring written consent.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any external funding, grants, or sponsorship. It was entirely self-funded and internally supported by the author's organization, Pietarien.
